title: 13% cap on depicted future returns in tools
description: In tools such as goal-planning calculators and return illustrations in non-scheme-related material, the higher range of the intended return depicted must not exceed 13%.
source_clause: AMFI Best Practices Guidelines Circular No. 109/2023-24 (usage of illustrations for future returns)

pass.content: Goal calculator illustration assuming returns in the 8%-12% range.
